title: Invites Mole and Rat to See His Caravan
description: Toad invites Mole and Rat to see his newly acquired caravan, proudly displaying its interior arrangements and provisions.

title: Reckless Behavior Discussed
description: Toad's reckless behavior is discussed by Rat and Mole during a snowstorm, including his seventh motor accident.

title: Arrives at Toad Hall in Motor-Clothing
description: Toad arrives at Toad Hall dressed in his usual motor-clothing, ready for another outing.

title: Imprisoned and Comforted by Gaoler's Daughter
description: Toad is imprisoned in a medieval fortress dungeon but begins to recover when the gaoler’s daughter brings him food and comforts him.

title: Escapes from Prison and Meets Barge Woman
description: Toad leaves his hollow tree home feeling free after escaping prison. He meets a barge woman who offers him a ride towards Toad Hall.

title: Rescued from Canal and Feels Remorseful
description: Toad is rescued by Rat after falling into a canal. He boasts about his adventures but feels remorseful when told that Stoats and Weasels have taken over Toad Hall.

title: Participates in Reclaiming Toad Hall
description: Toad, along with Mole, Badger, and Rat, enters a secret passage under the riverbank to reclaim Toad Hall from the Weasels.
